शाखोट śākhoṭa: ˚क -ka, m. N. of a small 🞄crooked ugly tree (Trophis aspera).
सखि sákh-i, m. (nm. ā) companion, associate, 🞄comrade, friend (sts. referring to a f., 🞄esp. = ī ˚—, metr.).

सखीय sakhī-ya, den. only pr. pt. associating 🞄oneself with, seeking the friendship of 🞄(in.;
 RV.).
सखोल sakhola, N. of a locality.

सख्य sakh-yá, n. association, friendship, for 🞄(lc.), with (in. ± samam, saha, sākam, sārdham;
 🞄—˚): -ṃ vi-dhā, look kindly (eyes) 🞄on (lc.).
